name: context-notion
description: Notion middle layer for context-kit: generic add-action, add-open-question, log-decision, query-decisions, update-action and the pending queue (add-pending / process-pending), all driven by the project's context.json state.notion block — database IDs, property schemas and roster — so one install serves every Notion-backed project. Requires the Notion connector and the context-kit plugin.
